feature: M15, reviewed work-history import while account ownership changes
relative_change: Four files used only by E2E tests connect two synthetic recommendation targets. Runtime frontend, backend, database and data files are identical for these revisions.
environment: GitHub-hosted real Chromium driving the production frontend build, repository backend and a loopback synthetic auth/account service. Production account storage was not used.
observations: An anonymous visitor uploaded their own synthetic Positions.csv via the normal experience library and reviewed the parsed employer before confirmation.
The same browser signed into a separate pre-seeded account from another tab. The original tab discarded the previous visitor’s unconfirmed preview before reload.
After reload the original saved account profile and importer were available with no previous-visitor employer. The old tab issued no account writes and the seeded account retained revision one.
The original two-Home-tabs profile-read regression passed in the same browser run.
